summary.body: Northborough, Southborough, and Northborough-Southborough Regional School Committees
summary.headline: School committees approved revisions to district policies on controversial issues, concussions, and wellness, and advanced a statewide school calendar study resolution.
summary.summary: Meeting jointly on March 11, 2026, the Northborough, Southborough, and Regional School Committees approved five revised district policies covering controversial issues and speakers, middle school career pathway exploration, immunization rules, student wellness, and athletic concussions. The committees also reviewed the superintendent evaluation timeline, discussed a potential Massachusetts Association of School Committees resolution calling for a state study of school calendars, and adopted the 2026-2027 school committee meeting calendar. Two high school students offered public comment requesting clearer district guidelines for students taking religious and cultural holiday observances.

topics.title: Public comment on religious observance policy
topics.summary: Two Algonquin Regional High School juniors addressed the combined committees regarding the district religious observance policy. They suggested expanding policy wording to set clearer expectations so students do not face test or assignment pressures immediately around cultural or religious holidays such as Lunar New Year, and asked for transparent communication avenues for families.
key_details: Presenters were two Algonquin Regional High School juniors residing in Southborough.
Noted that application of current policy varies across classrooms when students take excused absences for holidays.
Suggested clear grace periods for assignments and tests and increased awareness during professional development.
School committee leadership encouraged them to continue collaborating with the policy subcommittee.
topics.outcome: Subcommittee leadership welcomed the feedback for future policy subcommittee review.

topics.title: Superintendent evaluation timeline and process
topics.summary: Superintendent Greg Martineau outlined the upcoming schedule for the 2025-2026 administrative evaluation. Evaluation survey forms and supporting goal evidence will be distributed to committee members in May, followed by meetings with committee chairs to assemble a draft evaluation.
key_details: Google Forms and evidence portfolios will be sent to committee members in May 2026.
Leadership review of submitted data will occur between May 25 and June 1, 2026.
The finalized evaluation will be presented publicly at the June 15, 2026 combined meeting.

topics.title: Second readings and approval of revised district policies
topics.summary: The committees reviewed and voted to approve second readings of five updated district policies. Approved items included policy I-360 defining controversial topics and speakers using reliable evidence standards, policy I-350 mandating middle school pathway exploration under state rules, policy J-120 clarifying Department of Public Health immunization rules and annual religious exemptions, policy J-320 updating wellness guidelines, and policy J-340 replacing proprietary ImPACT testing language with general baseline concussion testing at least every two years.
key_details: Policy I-360 (Controversial Issues/Speakers) clarifies that controversy excludes claims demonstrably false or unsupported by reliable scholarship.
Policy I-350 (Middle School Pathway Exploration) formalizes required career exploration curricula for grades 6-8.
Policy J-120 clarifies annual religious exemption requirements under Massachusetts Department of Public Health guidelines.
Policy J-340 shifts concussion protocols from specific ImPACT testing to general baseline testing such as Sway testing at least every two years.
Each committee voted separately on policies within their jurisdiction.
topics.outcome: All five policies approved by the respective committees.
topics.why_it_matters: Sets districtwide curriculum standards, health and vaccine exemption guidelines, and concussion protocols affecting all students and athletic programs.

topics.title: Draft MASC resolution on statewide school calendar study
topics.summary: The committees discussed sponsoring a resolution through the Massachusetts Association of School Committees (MASC) requesting a state-level study on school calendar configurations. The proposed study would examine how various calendar models across the state address the 180-day and 900/990-hour statutory requirements, vacation schedules, and religious observances.
key_details: A resolution sponsored by five school committees across at least two divisions goes directly to the MASC Delegate Assembly.
MASC resolution submission deadline is June 1, 2026.
Members recommended drafting a clear preamble explaining that the intent is to collect state data rather than mandate changes to local vacations or school breaks.
topics.outcome: Committees deferred formal voting to allow drafting of an explanatory preamble, with individual committees planning to vote in April 2026.

topics.title: Strategic plan reauthorization update
topics.summary: Superintendent Martineau reported on ongoing community outreach for the district five-year strategic plan renewal. The administration gathered 656 survey responses from community members, faculty, staff, and parents, and is completing focus group meetings with parent-teacher organizations and special education advisory groups.
key_details: 656 survey responses were collected across the communities.
Upcoming focus group sessions scheduled with parent-teacher organizations, Southborough SOS, ELPAC, and NSPAC.
Draft reauthorized strategic plan will be presented at the June 15, 2026 combined meeting ahead of planned fall adoption.
topics.outcome: Information presented; draft plan expected in June 2026.

topics.title: Approval of 2026-2027 school committee meeting dates
topics.summary: The committees reviewed the proposed schedule of regular and combined meetings for the 2026-2027 school year. A modification was approved to ensure the March 8, 2027 Southborough regular meeting and budget public hearing will be held in Southborough rather than Algonquin Regional High School.
key_details: Established full meeting dates calendar for Northborough, Southborough, Regional, and Combined committees for FY27.
Amended the location of the March 8, 2027 meeting so the Southborough budget hearing occurs in Southborough.
topics.outcome: Approved as amended by all three committees.

topics.title: Routine business
topics.summary: The superintendent noted there were no personnel updates. The committees approved the minutes of the December 3, 2025 combined open meeting and voted to adjourn.
key_details: Minutes of the December 3, 2025 combined open meeting were unanimously approved.
Meeting adjourned at approximately 6:20 PM.
